title: Endophytic Fungal DNA Extraction from Seeds Using Qiagen DNeasy Plant Mini
author: Eve Kenny

steps.title: Rinse seeds and add beads
steps.instruction: Place seeds in a microcentrifuge tube, rinse with ddH₂O, vortex with finger for 1 minute; replace water and repeat two more times. Transfer seeds to screw‑cap tubes and add ~100 µg (large spatula scoop) of mini beads.

steps.title: Add Buffer AP1 and grind
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL Buffer AP1 to each tube and grind seed coat with a micro‑pestle for 1 minute until the seed interior is exposed.

steps.title: Beadbeat and centrifuge cycles
steps.instruction: Place tubes in the beadbeater and run for 1 minute; then centrifuge for 1 minute at 12,000 rpm. Repeat the beadbeat‑centrifuge cycle three additional times for a total of four cycles (Sigma 112 Mini Centrifuge top speed).

steps.title: Incubate at 65 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 65 °C for 10 minutes, inverting the tube three times during incubation.

steps.title: Repeat Buffer AP1 addition and incubate
steps.instruction: Repeat the addition of Buffer AP1 and grinding as in Step 2, then incubate for 10 minutes or until foam has been brought down.

steps.title: Spin and collect lysate
steps.instruction: Briefly spin the tubes, then transfer the lysate to a new microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add Buffer P3 and ice incubation
steps.instruction: Add 130 µL Buffer P3 to the lysate, mix, and incubate on ice for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate for 5 minutes at 14,000 rpm.

steps.title: QIAshredder spin column cleanup
steps.instruction: Pipette the lysate onto a QIAshredder Mini spin column (lilac) placed in the supplied 2 mL collection tube; discard the pellet and the original tube; centrifuge for 2 minutes at 14,000 rpm.

steps.title: Transfer flow-through to new tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the flow‑through to a new microcentrifuge tube without disturbing the cell‑debris pellet; record the volume transferred (typically about 350 µL).

steps.title: Add Buffer AW1 to lysate
steps.instruction: Add 1.5 × the recovered lysate volume of Buffer AW1 (e.g., 350 µL lysate → 525 µL Buffer AW1), mix immediately by pipetting.

steps.title: Load mixture onto DNeasy column (first load)
steps.instruction: Pipette 650 µL of the mixture (including precipitate) onto the DNeasy Mini spin column (white) in a 2 mL collection tube; centrifuge for 1 minute at 8,000 rpm.

steps.title: Load remaining mixture onto column
steps.instruction: Discard flow‑through, add another 650 µL of the remaining mixture to the same column and collection tube; centrifuge for 1 minute at 8,000 rpm. Repeat this loading and centrifugation until all mixture is processed; discard the collection tube after the final discard.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW2 (first wash)
steps.instruction: Place the DNeasy Mini spin column into a new supplied 2 mL collection tube; add 500 µL Buffer AW2 and centrifuge for 1 minute at 8,000 rpm.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW2 (second wash)
steps.instruction: Discard the flow‑through, add a second 500 µL Buffer AW2 to the same column and collection tube; centrifuge for 2 minutes at 14,000 rpm to dry the membrane.

steps.title: Elute DNA with Buffer AE (first elution)
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a clean microcentrifuge tube; pipette 50 µL Buffer AE directly onto the membrane, incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature, then centrifuge for 1 minute at 8,000 rpm. (Optional: elute with 100 µL Buffer AE for higher overall yield, noting the resulting lower DNA concentration.)

steps.title: Elute DNA with Buffer AE (second elution)
steps.instruction: Repeat the elution step in a new microcentrifuge tube (second 50 µL Buffer AE elution). Note: using the same tube as the first elution dilutes the DNA too much.
